organization.fullName: Fifth Affiliated Hospital, Sun Yat-Sen University

identificationModule.briefTitle: Dachaihu Decoction Compound and Rhubarb Single Medicine in the Treatment of Acute Pancreatitis
identificationModule.officialTitle: Comparison of Clinical Efficacy of Dachaihu Decoction Compound and Rhubarb Single Medicine in the Treatment of Acute Pancreatitis

leadSponsor.name: Fifth Affiliated Hospital, Sun Yat-Sen University

descriptionModule.briefSummary: A large number of clinical studies have shown that oral administration, external application or enema of Chinese medicine can promote the recovery of gastrointestinal function and the absorption of pancreatic inflammation. The aims of the study is to explore the application of Dachaihu Decoction Compound (DDC)and Rhubarb Single Medicine (RSM) in the Treatment of Acute Pancreatitis.

armGroups.label: DDC(Dachaihu decoction compound) Group
armGroups.description: Treated with Dachaihu decoction compound and regular therapies

armGroups.label: RSM(rhubarb single medicine) Group
armGroups.description: Treated with rhubarb single medicine and regular therapies

armGroups.label: N Group
armGroups.description: Treated with regular therapies and without traditional Chinese medicine

interventions.name: Dachaihu decoction compound
interventions.description: Dachaihu decoction compound includes Bupleurum, Rhubarb, Citrus aurantium, Scutellaria, Pinellia, White Peony, Jujube, Ginger.

interventions.name: Regular therapies
interventions.description: Regular therapies, such as fluid therapy, for acute pancreatitis

primaryOutcomes.description: Significant and effective rate after 7 days of treatment

eligibilityModule.eligibilityCriteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Age from 18 to 65 years old
* Meet the diagnostic criteria of western medicine for acute pancreatitis, within 48 hours of onset
* Consent of the subjects, who sign the informed consent form

Exclusion Criteria:

* Women who are pregnant or breastfeeding
* Acute abdomen such as organic intestinal obstruction, gastrointestinal perforation, purulent cholangitis, etc.
* Patients with a history of severe heart, liver, kidney and other important organ diseases
* Patients with mental illness and malignant tumors
* People who have allergies, or are allergic to a certain drug ingredient
